inputs.description: discretize_contin_feature/get_discrete_bin over five (min,max) pairs including both degenerate seeds (min stuck at 100000.0, max stuck at 0.0), a constant column, and max<min; KLD(p,q) over ten hand-built vector pairs (ties in p, ties in q, q wholly below/above p, unequal sizes, negatives, a scrambled restatement of an earlier case, a wide dynamic range); KLDS<contin_t> driven directly with hand-built q_counters, two of them carrying non-integral counts so boost::accumulate's `int` init truncates; mutualInformation() for every feature subset of three boolean-input/contin-output tables; mutualInformation() per single feature of two contin-input tables; the same after scaling every count_t off the integers (so `unsigned flt_count` truncates); and mutualInformationBtwSets() on all of them. No RNG is involved anywhere in this probe, so no seed is recorded.
